rows.label: Flat INT
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 INT = 1 Attack before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: INT %
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 INT = 1 Attack before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: Defense (flat) — Invincible converts a level-scaling % (10%+) into INT
rows.semantics: Invincible: a level-scaling share of the TOTAL Defense (incl. Defense % and Divine Protection) becomes INT before INT % (part of STAT_DAMAGE); no flat-Attack channel; PvP opponent Defense stays at the current value

rows.label: Defense %
rows.semantics: Invincible: a level-scaling share of the TOTAL Defense (incl. Defense % and Divine Protection) becomes INT before INT % (part of STAT_DAMAGE); no flat-Attack channel; PvP opponent Defense stays at the current value

rows.label: CRIT_RATE %
rows.semantics: Book of Ancient (if equipped): Crit Damage follows the crit-rate change

rows.label: ATTACK_SPEED % (diminishing returns, factor 150)
rows.semantics: Athena's Gloves (if equipped): Max Damage follows; Bottle of Emotion (if equipped): Final Damage follows

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 2nd Job
rows.semantics: adds High Wisdom's (Crit Rate), Spell Mastery's (Min Damage) and Magic Acceleration's (Attack Speed) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 3rd Job
rows.semantics: adds Magic Critical's Crit Rate / Crit Damage level delta

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — All Skills
rows.semantics: adds High Wisdom, Magic Critical (Crit Rate / Crit Damage), Spell Mastery and Magic Acceleration level deltas

rows.label: Pig's Ribbon
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)

rows.label: Mushmom's Cap
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (Accuracy vs Evasion not modelled)

rows.label: Lunar Dew
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)
